notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for named object-registration fan-out. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies two reserved and named registered objects, discovery of both objects by two active subscribers, owner loopback suppression, callback counts, named object-handle and class lookups, identity round trips, and standard resignation cleanup. Attribute updates, object deletion semantics beyond cleanup, ownership, timestamped delivery, regions/DDM, custom transportation, MOM, save/restore, and provider-private behavior remain outside this contract.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador object-instance name reservation, named registration, identity lookup, publication, active subscription, unsubscription, unpublication, resignation, destruction, and disconnect services with FederateAmbassador reservation and discovery callbacks
